title: Trace-norm rigidity for reduced products of unitary groups and matrix algebras
summary: We study homomorphisms, with a focus on isomorphisms, between the tracial metric reduced products of finite dimensional unitary groups and of matrix algebras. A variant of Ulam stability for unitary groups and a classification of the almost surjective continuous homomorphisms between finite dimensional unitary groups are proved and then used to show that all isomorphisms of product form of these tracial reduced products are induced by almost permutations of the coordinates and coordinatewise application of automorphisms.
